acceptanceCriteria.text: Shell assets use stale-while-revalidate caching strategy
gameSrc in PWA mode does not include Date.now() cache-buster
SW version bumped and pre-caches game index.html
Service worker registers immediately (not waiting for load event)

snapshot.description: PWA should load near-instantly when installed. Issues: 1) Shell uses network-first (slow offline), 2) gameSrc uses Date.now() cache-busting which prevents SW from caching game, 3) SW version needs bump for new strategies
snapshot.title: Improve PWA load performance: faster shell caching and no cache-busting

changes.newValue: SW v4: stale-while-revalidate for shell (instant loads), cache-first for game assets, pre-caches game/index.html. gameSrc no longer cache-busts in PWA mode. SW registers immediately on page load.
